provenance.method: Each complete printed variant verse is compared with the recording using STFT and constant-Q features; the four shared opening notes of an independent original MIDI are checked with the same two features. All four onset estimates agree within 0.5 seconds. Printed notes are individually recognized, rhythm is manually reviewed, and the initial region is shown from zero. Neither a complete MIDI variant nor human listening is claimed.
